name: GreenEcho Floating Chat Button
author: Prakash Sahu

sections.description:
GreenEcho Floating Chat Button provides a seamless way for your customers to reach out to you via WhatsApp with a single click. Optimized for speed and mobile users.

Why choose GreenEcho?
In a crowded market of chat plugins, GreenEcho stands out by being developer-friendly and extremely easy to configure. We don’t load heavy libraries or tracking scripts.

🚀 UPGRADE TO PRO VERSION
Take your customer support to the next level with our Pro features:
* WooCommerce Auto-Product Link: Automatically sends the product name and price to your WhatsApp.
* Multiple Agents: Add different numbers for Sales, Support, and Billing.
* Custom Styling: Change colors, size, and icons to match your brand.
* Priority Updates: Get the latest features before anyone else.

Get GreenEcho Pro Now – Limited Time Offer!

Key Features

  • Zero Lag: Highly optimized code.
  • Mobile Optimized: Direct app triggers for seamless chat.
  • Custom Branding: Easily configure agent names and numbers.
  • Lightweight UI: Clean, modern SVG-based icon.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> GreenEcho Chat menu to configure.
